results.question: Quantos passageiros teve a rota BJP para GRU?
results.answer: A rota BJP → GRU não está entre as 200 rotas mais movimentadas disponíveis; portanto, os números de passageiros pagos não estão disponíveis neste conjunto de dados.

sources.unit: movements: takeoffs plus landings, as a count
passengers: paid passengers per leg, as a count; loadFactor: ratio from 0 to 1

caveats: Covers Brazilian public aerodromes with published coordinates, ranked by movements. Movements do not measure congestion or delays.
Only the 200 busiest routes by paid passengers are available, in IATA codes. A route missing here may still exist.
